data.name: Charm Industrial
data.description: Charm Industrial is a San Francisco-based pure-play CDR company that uses fast pyrolysis to convert agricultural and forestry residues into bio-oil, which is injected into EPA-regulated wells for permanent geological sequestration. The company also produces biochar as a secondary product and counts Frontier, Google, JPMorgan Chase, and Workday among its major offtake customers.
